title: Top 10 locations
content: This is not an exhaustive list but these locations are common in my mallworld dreams. I have listed them in no particular order. **Within the mall:** - thrift store / knick-knacks store - arcade - grocery store - backrooms labyrinth **Not within the mall but still in mallworld:** - filthy bathrooms - school - resort/amusement park - residential neighborhood - college campus - futuristic city A common denominator is the sense of being pursued, the feeling that you are not supposed to be there, feeling trapped, and the location is easy to get lost in or like a labyrinth. And there's just this unexplainable feeling that tells you these locations are a part of mallworld. What are your top 10 locations?
